svg.title: Stitchwork: Cross-stitch pattern chart
svg.desc: Stitchwork (1D): the mend drawn as a cross-stitch pattern chart. A torn seam runs across two felt panels on the counted grid; the stitches already made are bold crosses of bone thread over the gap, and the numbered entry points still to come wait to the right. The needle cursor hovers at point 6, and the margin counts five stitches done of eight with the tension in the band.
